steps: 1. In the Modded Keep, equip a mod-only weapon and mod-only hat/outfit on the active career. Record the corresponding official baseline first.
2. Open **Mod Tweaker > Equipment**, choose **Default**, confirm and **Apply**.
3. Inspect the visible character immediately, without reopening another menu; watch for stale gear, repeated equips or repeated respawns.
4. Repeat the reset during Adventure. Finish or leave normally and inspect the character at the next safe Keep boundary.
5. Return to the Official Realm and compare its recorded selections without changing them. Retain the logs.
assertions: Keep reset immediately presents official defaults, with at most one necessary skin-change respawn. Mission reset persists and reconciles at the next safe Keep boundary. No stale mod-only item, equip storm or official-data mutation remains.
Keep: equip mod-only weapon and hat, run DEFAULT; assert live inventory slot item keys and hat attachment equal the new backend rows, at most one respawn, official rows unchanged.
